caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot rendered in pencil on a light beige background. The teapot has a bulbous body with a rounded top and a fitted lid that features a conical knob with a stacked, finial-like design. The handle, attached to the left side, is curvaceous with a loop at the top end and a subtle decorative band at the midpoint. The spout, extending from the right, is long, slender, and curves upward before tapering to a pointed tip. The teapot is detailed with subtle shading to suggest its metallic appearance and rounded form. Near the lower right of the drawing, a horizontal scale is labeled “Scale of Inches,” marked from 0 to 3, with “Samuel O. Klein” written beneath it. The overall composition centers the teapot with no additional objects or background elements present.
title: Pewter Teapot
